Most of this was already in the spec from your earlier request, so I only closed one gap. `piton check` reports no problems and `piton build` wrote 86 files.

- **Research:** a read-only run whose findings are saved and can be read (`#research`).
- **Pause:** once research ends, planning pauses and sending the sprint is disabled. It also stops the next sprint from starting automatically. Only Resume or "Approve and send sprint" ends it.
- **Visible and lasting:** a "Paused for review" bar and tab markers show the pause, and it's saved so it survives reloads and restarts (`#paused`).

**What I added** (`.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#paused`): "nothing is implemented" now also covers a sprint that's already underway.
- **Held:** current-sprint stories still waiting in the queue are held in place, marked "Held for review", with their lane waiting. A story's next step is held the same way.
- **Not held:** a story already running when the pause began finishes, since stopping it would leave work half done. The bar says how many are still running.
- **After the pause:** once you resume or approve, everything held carries on in its original order.

**Anchors the code should follow:** `Planning` `#paused`, `#research`, `#auto-start` and `#steps`, and `QueueList` `#editing` for how held prompts behave.

content.content:
Its findings are a document of their own, "Research: <topic>", rendered as markdown with its links clickable, shown in a Findings list beneath the Backlog, newest first, each a row with its topic, when it ran, and its state, and opening in a body tab of its own to read whole. Findings started from a story are also listed in that story, beneath its steps. They are saved with the plan, in `.suspense/planning/research/`, a markdown file each, so they can be read again later, and can be deleted from their row's menu.

## Paused

Once research ends, however it ended, planning is paused. While it is paused nothing is implemented: Send sprint, the ribbon's Send Sprint, and the sprint's Ctrl+Shift+Enter are disabled, their tooltips saying planning is paused for review, and no proposal from the research is added to the plan by itself. Stories can still be written, edited, ordered, and moved, and proposals still accepted or rejected one by one, since those only change the plan.
Nothing of the plan starts while it is paused, not only nothing new: a story of Current sprint still waiting in the queue, not yet started, is held where it is, as a queued prompt being edited is held, as the [QueueList](../prompt-mode/queue-list/index.md#queue-list) says, its row reading "Held for review", muted, and its lane waits on it; a story already running when the pause began runs on to its end, since stopping it would leave its work half done, and the bar says how many are still running. A chain's next step, as a story's steps are sent, is held the same way. Once the pause ends, by Resume or Approve, what was held goes on in its order, as though nothing had stopped it.
The pause is plain to see: a bar across the top of Planning, in the theme's warning colour, with a pause icon, reads "Paused for review", names the research it is waiting on, with a link that opens its findings, and holds two buttons, "Resume", which ends the pause, and "Approve and send sprint", which ends it and sends Next sprint at once. The Planning tab in the body shows a small pause icon beside its name, and the ribbon's Planning tab a warning dot, while it is paused. Pressing either button is the only way the pause ends; nothing the agent does, and no time passing, ends it. A second research while paused keeps the pause, naming the latest.
The pause is saved with the plan, in `order.json`, with the research it waits on, as soon as it begins, so it is still paused, and still shown so, after the project is closed and opened again, the application restarted, or the window reloaded, until it is resumed or approved.
45:Each queued prompt in the list also has a button with a pencil icon, after its move buttons and before its cancel button, whose tooltip says it edits the prompt. Clicking it edits the prompt in the [ChatInput](../chat-input/index.md#chat-input), as it says, and its row is highlighted while it is being edited. While it is, it is held where it is: it is never sent, and its lane, waiting on it, waits, even with auto-send on; the other lane carries on. Saving the edit puts the new text, in the mode and with the attachments it was saved with, in its place in the queue, saved with the project in

content.text:
A paused plan now also holds a sprint that's already underway, but none of it is compiled or tested. The build script calls `piton compile`, which this sandbox blocks; I only checked that the files parse with rustfmt. Please run `cargo test` before relying on it.

The rest of what you asked for was already in the code: research runs read-only and saves findings, it pauses planning, Send sprint is disabled, and the pause bar, tab markers and saved pause in `order.json` all exist. What's new, following `#paused`:

- **Waiting stories are held:** while planning is paused, a Current sprint story still in the queue, or a queued step of one, is never sent. Its lane waits on it even with auto-send on, the same way a queued prompt being edited is held. The other lane carries on.
